surprises.head: Anton Forsberg got lit up
surprises.body: Forsberg allowed 5 goals on 25 shots, worth 1.7 expected goals: 3.3 more than expected. Starting goalies have a night this rough about once every 50 starts.

story.head: The Sharks steal one
paras: Darnell Nurse played his 800th NHL game. Ivar Stenberg picked up his first NHL point. Adrian Kempe struck first for the Kings on the power play late in the first. Tyler Toffoli made it 1-1 on the power play early in the second. Kiefer Sherwood put the Sharks up 2-1 midway through the second. Nolan Allan scored his first goal for San Jose 2:40 later to make it 3-1. Quinton Byfield made it 3-2 on the power play late in the second. Igor Chernyshov made it 4-2 for the Sharks early in the third. Erik Haula scored his first goal for Los Angeles midway through the third to pull the Kings within one. Artemi Panarin made it 4-4 with 5:00 left. Chernyshov won it with his second goal of the night in overtime. Chernyshov also had an assist.

The Sharks got away with one. The Kings had the better of the play. Replay the chances a hundred times and the Kings win about seven in ten. Yaroslav Askarov made 31 saves for the Sharks, and Anton Forsberg allowed five goals on 25 shots. The Sharks moved to 2-0-0, and the Kings dropped to 0-1-1.

items.text: Mats Zuccarello extended his point streak against San Jose to six games.
